plants.sentence: R-squared and the correlation coefficient cannot be swung by a single data point, so they are robust summaries that make the plot unnecessary.
When residual plots show curvature, adding powers of a predictor always captures the relationship exactly and guarantees a correct model.
A categorical variable with c groups needs c + 1 indicator variables, one for every group plus one for the baseline.
Least squares picks the line that makes the sum of the squared prediction errors as small as possible, a method Gauss devised to track asteroids.
Each slope shows how much a one-unit increase in its predictor causes the response to change, so the model proves what drives the outcome.
